s.note: Georgia cooking gourmet dishes alone in her kitchen
s.how: Mix 300g crab meat with 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, spring onion and lemon zest. Shape 12 cakes, chill, then fry in butter 3 minutes a side. Serve with mayonnaise mixed with lemon juice.

s.note: the Grandhotel Pupp in the Czech mountains
s.how: Fry 250g sliced mushrooms with garlic and thyme. Cut 1 sheet puff pastry into 12 squares, top with mushrooms and 80g gruyère and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

m.note: Chef Didier's dishes at the hotel
m.how: Score 4 duck breasts and cook skin side down for 8 minutes, then roast at 200C for 6 minutes. Make a sauce from 200ml orange juice, 2 tbsp honey and stock. Serve with 800g roast potatoes.

w.note: ordering every dessert at the hotel
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool. Fold through 300ml whipped cream and 2 beaten egg whites. Spoon into 6 glasses, chill 2 hours and top with 125g raspberries.

d.note: living it up at the grand hotel
d.how: Chill 750ml sparkling wine and 750ml sparkling apple juice. Pour into flutes. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
